items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: just wire brushes and little things, there playing behind Perry Como and Dorothy

ctx.x: Oh yes. That's what I was telling you before, Bill, when Frank Sinatra came down to see me. Well I had

a trio, the hours at CBS weren't bad, we used to do that Good Morning Blues program, we were out of there at 3:00 in the afternoon, and we were through until the next morning at 8:00. Now of course during that time from 8 till 3, we had a lot of time in between. Do the Good Morning Blues program and maybe rehearse an hour after that. We were through about 10:30, 11:00. We were off then until about one, come back and rehearse Perry Como and Dorothy Collins and we were through until the next morning. So we didn't…
